Storage Instructions: Store this product at room temperature, ensuring it is kept away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Medications should not be flushed down the toilet or poured into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. When the product is expired or no longer needed, dispose of it properly. Formulary Information and Plan Comparison: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider. When sending this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
